author: Murphh
body:
I would like to see a build area on the server, so I can build with other players.

I spend time building structures during games in walls and nebula.  Every once in awhile an annoying player comes by and tries to kill me.  Most of the time they succeed. :P
Geez - what is their problem?!?

I'd like to build in peace, so here's the idea:

Have a build map. Have chests set up with popular items in stacks.  You could reset the map every day.  Or have a specified area that stays and doesn't get deleted for players who want to keep their masterpieces.

Here are builds that I tried on jungle and village (walls), but didn't get to finish.

replies.body:
Yeah, but that's the point.  Go ahead and build your dirt house.  It's not a contest.  Just get an idea...and build with fellow builders.  Who really cares what it looks like.  It's just fun to see what players come up with. 

Hum... griefers not allowed. I don't know what to do about them.
